description: Moving the cursor to a point 2px above the panel edge over the enlarged icon keeps hover and zoom through the Zoom Overflow input area.

assertions.comment: After moving into the Zoom Overflow area above the panel, the first icon remains at maximum zoom 1.6
Even 2px above the default panel boundary, DockItem considers the pointer inside the zoom interaction area
With the cursor at the icon center, panel-relative y is negative — the pointer is captured in the area where the enlarged icon extends above the panel
